limitations: Retailer references confirm the 2026/27 season but do not expose a manufacturer SKU on the captured page.
The converted amount is a European promotional retail reference, not a Chinese retail price.
Shipping, payment conversion costs, customs duties, and import taxes are excluded.
Prices and inventory can change after capture.
